A data row with fewer cells than the header is padded to the declared column count

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th><th>C</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td></tr></table>')
puts result.inspect
```
